description: Test suite for sandbox-tool-policy functions using vitest, verifying policy merging logic and configuration resolution.

methods.name: pickSandboxToolPolicy
methods.description: Selects sandbox tool policy based on configuration object, merging allow and alsoAllow arrays accordingly.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the effective tool policy considering global configuration and agent ID.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsRootExpansionAllowed
methods.description: Determines whether file system root expansion is allowed based on configuration and agent ID.

ctags.name: resolved
ctags.pattern: /^    const resolved = resolveEffectiveToolPolicy({ config: cfg, agentId: "main" });$/
